blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: Notice also the following expressions: Прошла неделя. — A week went by. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Notice also the following expressions: Прошла неделя. — A week went by.

exercises.why: Other meanings from the prefix table: вы- — Step out for a short period of time: Секретарь вышел на десять минут. — The secretary left for ten minutes. под- — Подвезти – give someone a lift: Он подвёз меня до центра. — He took me (as far as) downtown. от- — With transitive verbs, delivering or dropping something off (agent does not remain): Я отнесу книги в библиотеку, потом приду. — I'll drop the book off at the library, then come. до- — Characterizing the duration of a journey, especially when it is long: Мы наконец доехали до дачи. — We finally reached the dacha. пере- — Changing residence: Я переехала в другой город. — I moved to another city. про- — Movement beyond one's destination (possibly unintentional): Я боюсь, что мы уже прошли магазин. — I'm afraid we already passed the store. на- — Quantified movement: Водитель наездил 50 километров. — The driver covered 50 kilometers. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The past tense is formed by dropping **-ть** from the infinitive and adding **-л** for the masculine, **-ла** for the feminine, **-ло** for the neuter, **-ли** for the plural: **работал**, **работала**, **работало**, **работали**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 36, 42.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: В прошлом году здесь провели несколько новых дорог.* Notice also the following expressions: Прошла неделя. — A week went by. Дождь прошёл. — The rain stopped. Other meanings from the prefix table: вы- — Step out for a short period of time: Секретарь вышел на десять минут. — The secretary left for ten minutes. под- — Подвезти – give someone a lift: Он подвёз меня до центра. — He took me (as far as) downtown. от- — With transitive verbs, delivering or dropping something off (agent does not remain): Я отнесу книги в библиотеку, потом приду. — I'll drop the book off at the library, then come. до- — Characterizing the duration of a journey, especially when it is long: Мы наконец доехали до дачи. — We finally reached the dacha. пере- — Changing residence: Я переехала в другой город. — I moved to another city. про- — Movement beyond one's destination (possibly unintentional): Я боюсь, что мы уже прошли магазин. — I'm afraid we already passed the store. на- — Quantified movement: Водитель наездил 50 километров. — The driver covered 50 kilometers.* — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: **нанести / наносить** — to drift (on); to carry, to waft, to deposit, to wash ashore (e.g. of snow, sand, etc.); to mark (on); to draw (e.g. onto a map); to inflict (on); to cause (to); to bring. **сойти / сходить** — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; (figuratively) to come off, to disappear, to go from; to pass by; (figuratively) to pass for, to be taken for. **обойтись / обходиться** — to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); to walk through, to wander around, to go around, to tour, to go to (many places in an area); to overtake, to outrank, to beat, to outperform (a peer or competitor). — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
